t: Petpet Park | Neopets History | Book of Ages
s: Wardrobe Wars - A game in which players had to customise Petpets to match specific looks. Wizard Walk - A game in which players had to rush along a path while parts of it disappeared. Later in the game's development homes and gardens were added that could be customised in a similar fashion to Neohomes on Neopets. Achievements were also added that awarded badges for specific activities, such as harvesting so many berries from bushes in the Park. Eventually, users were also given the option of buying a Petpetpet for their Petpet (similar to Neopets being given Petpets).
